title: Reginfo.gov Unified Agenda entry: RIN 0945-AA22, HIPAA Security Rule to Strengthen the Cybersecurity of Electronic Protected Health Information

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

publisher: Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs, OMB / GSA (reginfo.gov)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency is also the party proposing and administering the requirement. Agenda dates are agency projections and frequently slip. Publication date not shown on the entry page; the pubId=202510 edition is the one the site labels "2026" in its navigation.
findings: The entry lists the NPRM as published 01/06/2025 at 90 FR 898.
In this edition the Agenda Stage of Rulemaking is "Long-Term Actions" with Final Action projected 07/00/2027.
The earlier Spring 2025 edition (pubId=202504) listed the stage as Final Rule Stage with Final Action 05/00/2026.
The entry flags the rule as Economically Significant and Major, with Small Entities Affected: Businesses, Governmental Jurisdictions, Organizations.
limitations: A Federal Register API search on 2026-11-04 (terms "Security Rule", "HIPAA Security Rule", RIN 0945-AA22, published after 2025-01-07) returned no final rule or withdrawal for this RIN; this is absence of evidence from one search, not proof.
The page also lists a newer Spring 2026 agenda edition that could not be read (pubId=202604 returned an empty shell), so the latest projection may differ.
